title.zh: CrowdCell Pledge 类型脚本 约束

subtitle.zh: 来源：alesfer001/CrowdCell / contracts/pledge/src/main.rs@acbb40e（自 2fd13f6 起未改动）　·　0xe45d…b024 (data2，仅测试网，2026-10-31 重新部署)　·　社区合约，未经独立审计
subtitle.en: Source: alesfer001/CrowdCell / contracts/pledge/src/main.rs@acbb40e (unchanged since 2fd13f6)　·　0xe45d…b024 (data2, testnet only, redeployed 2026-10-31)　·　community contract, not independently audited

outputs.label: pledge
outputs.body: Cell{ type: { codeHash: PLEDGE, hashType: data2, args: receipt_code_hash 32B }, lock: PLEDGE_LOCK, data: {{campaign_id≠0}} ‖ {{backer_lock_hash≠0}} ‖ {{amount>0}} }

label.zh: 同交易的 receipt（本脚本不检查）
label.en: receipt in the same tx (not checked here)

body.zh: Cell{ type: { codeHash: args[0..32], args: 64B }, capacity: 300 CKB, data[0..8] = 认捐额 u64 LE }，由 receipt 合约检查；2026-10-31 测试网交易中的观察
body.en: Cell{ type: { codeHash: args[0..32], args: 64B }, capacity: 300 CKB, data[0..8] = pledged amount u64 LE }, checked by the receipt contract; as observed in 2026-10-31 testnet txs

role.zh: campaign 标识；合并与部分退款时输入输出须相同（资金路由以 pledge-lock args 为准）
role.en: campaign id; must match across inputs and output on merge and partial refund (routing is decided by pledge-lock args)

role.zh: 认捐人 lock hash（本脚本只检查非零；退款去向由 pledge-lock args 决定）
role.en: backer lock hash (only non-zero is checked here; refund destination is set by pledge-lock args)

role.zh: receipt 合约 code_hash；部分退款时用它找 receipt 输入
role.en: receipt contract code_hash; used to find the receipt input on partial refund

cons.zh: 仅比较 code_hash，不比较完整 type script
cons.en: only the code_hash is compared, not the full type script

cond.zh: ≥ 72 字节（只检查第一个 group 输出）
cond.en: ≥ 72 bytes (only the first group output is checked)

title.zh: 合并（≥2 输入 → 1 输出）

cond.zh: 每个输入与输出 data ≥ 72 字节
cond.en: every input and the output data ≥ 72 bytes
same in every input and the output

cond.zh: 读取 group 输入 / 输出数据失败
cond.en: failure to load group input / output data

body.zh: type code_hash = args[0..32] 的输入 cell，data[0..8] = {{a − a′}}（仅 args ≥ 32 字节时要求）
body.en: input cell whose type code_hash = args[0..32], data[0..8] = {{a − a′}} (required only when args ≥ 32 bytes)

cond.zh: 输入与输出 data ≥ 72 字节
输出 amount < 输入 amount
args ≥ 32 字节时：输入中第一个（data ≥ 8B 的）receipt 金额 = 差值
cond.en: when args ≥ 32 bytes: first receipt input (data ≥ 8B) amount = difference

cond.zh: args ≥ 32 字节时输入中必须有 receipt
cond.en: when args ≥ 32 bytes a receipt must be in inputs

cond.zh: 读取输入 / 输出 / receipt 数据失败
cond.en: failure to load input / output / receipt data

title.zh: 销毁（释放或退款结算时）

cond.zh: 总是允许（资金去向由 pledge-lock 约束）
既非 n→1（n≥2 且恰好 1 个输出）也非 1→1（1 个输入且 1 个输出）
cond.en: neither n→1 (n≥2 and exactly 1 output) nor 1→1 (1 input and 1 output)

notes.zh: 错误码（main.rs）：1 data 过短 · 3 campaign_id=0 · 4 backer=0 · 5 amount=0 · 7 NO_SCRIPT · 9 LOAD_DATA · 10 MODIFICATION_NOT_ALLOWED · 11 MERGE_DIFFERENT_CAMPAIGNS · 12 MERGE_AMOUNT_MISMATCH · 13 OVERFLOW · 14 CAMPAIGN_MISMATCH · 15 PARTIAL_REFUND_INVALID · 16 REFUND_AMOUNT_MISMATCH · 17 NO_RECEIPT_IN_INPUTS
notes.en: Error codes (main.rs): 1 data too short · 3 campaign_id=0 · 4 backer=0 · 5 amount=0 · 7 NO_SCRIPT · 9 LOAD_DATA · 10 MODIFICATION_NOT_ALLOWED · 11 MERGE_DIFFERENT_CAMPAIGNS · 12 MERGE_AMOUNT_MISMATCH · 13 OVERFLOW · 14 CAMPAIGN_MISMATCH · 15 PARTIAL_REFUND_INVALID · 16 REFUND_AMOUNT_MISMATCH · 17 NO_RECEIPT_IN_INPUTS

notes.zh: type args 可选：≥ 32 字节时前 32 字节为 receipt 合约 code_hash，只按 code_hash 匹配（同一 code_hash 的任何 receipt 输入都算数）；不足 32 字节则部分退款不要求 receipt
notes.en: type args optional: when ≥ 32 bytes the first 32 are the receipt code_hash, matched by code_hash only (any receipt input with that code_hash counts); shorter args mean partial refunds need no receipt

notes.zh: 创建时输出个数不限，只检查第一个 group 输出；合并要求恰好 1 个 group 输出，否则落入 m → k（错误 10）
notes.en: Creation accepts any number of group outputs and checks only the first; merge requires exactly one group output, otherwise the shape falls to m → k (error 10)

notes.zh: 是否计入 campaign 不由本脚本决定：campaign 类型脚本（contracts/campaign/src/main.rs，sum_campaign_pledges）按 pledge-lock code_hash、lock args 中的 campaign hash 与 deadline（bytes 32–40）筛选，并读取 data[64..72] 累加（见 campaign 卡）
notes.en: Whether a pledge counts toward a campaign is not decided here: the campaign type script (contracts/campaign/src/main.rs, sum_campaign_pledges) selects pledges by pledge-lock code_hash, the campaign hash and deadline in lock args (bytes 32–40), and sums data[64..72] (see the campaign card)

notes.zh: 截至 2026-11-04，测试网上没有任何合并或部分退款交易（对 pledge 类型脚本检索：没有交易含 2 个以上 pledge 输入，也没有同时含 pledge 输入和 pledge 输出的交易）；这两条路径目前只有源码依据，未经链上验证
notes.en: As of 2026-11-04 there is no merge or partial-refund transaction on testnet (a search of the pledge type script finds no tx with two or more pledge inputs, and none with a pledge input and a pledge output); these two paths rest on source reading only, not on-chain runs
